sourceSupportedFacts: Dhika parks her bike at college at about 8:35 in the morning and hears Bantu behind her.

Dhika blushes, tells him to shush, recognizes him before turning, and hopes nobody else is around.

Dhika asks where Bobby is; Bantu points him out, and Dhika waves at Bobby while he is farther away pushing his bike.
